issue.title: Symvision flags LaunchPromptContext as public although it is file-local
issue.description: On HEAD a65988db8e8389696270d840d756b45ec54479f0, `sase tool run check` exits at `lint (symvision)` with a NEW finding for `LaunchPromptContext` in `src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner_setup_prompt.py`. The class is referenced only within its defining module (the `launch_context` type and factory return), so it should be private while preserving its local use. The same finding appeared in two separate `just _lint-symvision` runs; the separate `OutboxGroup` finding was triaged KNOWN and is out of scope.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Two separate just _lint-symvision runs on this SHA and the requested sase tool run check all report the same unused-public symbol, making this deterministic rather than intermittent.

issue.creation_reason: The requested check stops at this independent static-analysis failure before its scoped test lane can run. It needs a focused fix for the unused-public report.
